screenshots.head: The AI podcast player that runs on your ChatGPT account
screenshots.sub: Sign in once. Summaries, answers and saved takeaways use the plan you already have.

screenshots.label: Capture
screenshots.head: One tap saves the last 60 seconds
screenshots.sub: ChatGPT writes the takeaway, linked to the passage it came from.

screenshots.label: Understand
screenshots.head: Summary and chapters for an episode
screenshots.sub: Written from the transcript. Jump to any chapter.

screenshots.label: Ask
screenshots.head: Ask the episode
screenshots.sub: Answers come from the transcript, with sources you can replay.

screenshots.label: Share
screenshots.head: Turn a saved idea into a share card
screenshots.sub: ChatGPT writes the words. The card is drawn on your phone.

screenshots.label: Private
screenshots.head: Transcribed on your phone
screenshots.sub: Episode audio is not uploaded for transcription.

screenshots.label: Connect
screenshots.head: Sign in with ChatGPT. No API key to create.
screenshots.sub: AI requests use your plan's allowance. Plan limits apply.

feature.head: The AI podcast player that runs on your ChatGPT account
